title: thermoLEO Tomography v1
description: Multi-band altitude skewness of LEO satellites (2014-2025), computed from public TLE data for a fixed population of 4,108 Sun-synchronous satellites. 11 altitude bands from 550 to 1550 km.

columns.n_satellites: Number of satellites in the band that year
columns.skewness: Third standardized moment of altitude distribution

method: Per year and band, the skewness of the altitude distribution is computed. Satellites are assigned to bands based on their initial (2014) altitude, and tracked over time.
